episodes.title: The $$60 Billion Man
episodes.summary: After Meryl and Milly's search for the legendary Vash the Stampede leads them to an encounter with a group of dangerous bounty hunters, an unlikely hero arrives to save them.

episodes.title: Truth of Mistake
episodes.summary: Meryl and Milly seek shelter in the mansion of Cliff Schezar, a wealthy man who has hired Vash as a bodyguard. Have the girls finally found the infamous gunslinger? or is Cliff hiding something.

episodes.title: Peace Maker
episodes.summary: Vash is looking for a renowned gunsmith named Frank Marion, he finds him - but the legendary gunsmith is a drunken mess! Making things worse, a group of bandits has learned that there is no sheriff in town!

episodes.title: Love and Peace
episodes.summary: Vash finds himself in the middle of a hostage crisis when outlaws take the mayor's daughter - and Meryl and Milly captive. He quickly discovers that these bad guys might not actually be the bad guys!

episodes.title: Hard Puncher
episodes.summary: With the entire town after the bounty on his head, Vash must contend with the dangerously destructive Nebraska Brothers, while saving the very villagers who are bent on bringing him in!

episodes.title: Lost July
episodes.summary: Vash is completely smitten with Elizabeth, a stunning beauty who has arrived in town to repair the local plant. Hopefully Vash isn't too distracted by her charms - because the enemy is very close indeed!

episodes.title: B.D.N.
episodes.summary: Aboard a sand steamer, Vash meets a kid named Kaite, who might be up to no good, and finds himself going up against the notorious Bad Lad Gang.

episodes.title: And Between the Wasteland and Sky
episodes.summary: The Bad Lads and their ruthless leader, B.D. Neon, have control of the steamer! With the captain steering the vessel toward disaster, Vash must act quick to save the people on board.

episodes.title: Murder Machine
episodes.summary: During a bus trip to May City, Vash, Meryl and Milly encounter a priest named Nicholas D. Wolfwood. Before too long, the travelers find their journey interrupted by a horde of attacking robotic spiders.

episodes.title: Quick Draw
episodes.summary: Vash and Wolfwood enter a quick-draw competition in May City, if one of them wins, the prize money goes to a poor local family. Unfortunately, they're both in the line of fire - the contest is rigged!

episodes.title: Escape from Pain
episodes.summary: Things get complicated when the gang gets tangled up in the drama surrounding a runaway dancing girl and the son of a caravan owner.

episodes.title: Diablo
episodes.summary: Vash is thrown in jail after being accused of killing a local shoemaker. Even if he gets out of his cell, there's going to be trouble - Money the Gale is gunning for him after being hired by Legato!

episodes.title: Vash the Stampede
episodes.summary: Meryl files a report the Bernadelli Insurance Company, recounting the many exploits, misadventures and lunatic moments of Vash The Stampede.
